encoder.name: DeepCellMorpho DINOv2 ViT-S/16
encoder.license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; research only; code Apache2.0
encoder.normalization: Each image channel percentile clipping0.01/99.9 then minmax[0,1]; constant channels zero; two zero padding channels as author BBBC adaptation
encoder.adaptation: Native128 cell-context crops; matches author local crop size; positional interpolation; not original full-FoV evaluation

segmentation.threshold: Otsu on Gaussian-smoothed DAPI after broad background subtraction
segmentation.method: Distance-watershed nuclei; seeded intensity-gradient approximate cell territory; nucleus-centered crops
segmentation.selection: Seeded uniform eligible cells; label-independent; reject crop truncation
